lines.text: He held the door. Say thanks!

data.define: A British way to say thank you or goodbye.

misuse.text: Don't expect Americans to understand 'cheers' as thanks.

data.l1_hook: Ele segurou a porta. Diga cheers!

native.caption:
O que significa “cheers”?
“cheers” = saúde.
Exemplo: “Cheers for the lift!” (Cheers pela carona!)
